definitionZh: min-block大小的 CSS 属性定义元素块的最小水平大小或垂直大小,取决于其写入模式. 根据写法-模式的值,它或对应分钟宽度,或对应分钟高度属性.
sourceDefinition: The min-block-size CSS property defines the minimum horizontal or vertical size of an element's block, depending on its writing mode. It corresponds to either the min-width or the min-height property, depending on the value of writing-mode.
